test_cases.name: happy_path_parallel_fork_join
test_cases.description: Concurrent execution of three independent branches with ordered concatenation join.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-lint-001 with 3 tasks, barrier_timeout_ms 30000, error_policy FAIL_ALL_ON_ANY_ERROR, and ORDERED_LIST_CONCAT.
expected_output_patterns: === FORK-JOIN DISPATCH INITIALIZED: Batch: batch-lint-001 Branches: 3 ===

test_cases.name: barrier_timeout_straggler_cancellation
test_cases.description: Barrier timeout expires with active in-flight worker cancellation and partial join.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-fetch-002 with 4 branches and barrier_timeout_ms 5000. Branch 3 hangs past 5000ms.
expected_output_patterns: === FORK-JOIN DISPATCH INITIALIZED: Batch: batch-fetch-002 Branches: 4 ===

test_cases.name: single_branch_boundary_condition
test_cases.description: Single task fork-join execution boundary condition.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-single-001 with 1 task and barrier_timeout_ms 10000.
expected_output_patterns: === FORK-JOIN DISPATCH INITIALIZED: Batch: batch-single-001 Branches: 1 ===

test_cases.name: error_policy_fail_all_on_any_error
test_cases.description: One worker fails under FAIL_ALL_ON_ANY_ERROR policy, triggering halt with BRANCH_EXECUTION_FAILURE.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-strict-001 with error_policy FAIL_ALL_ON_ANY_ERROR where branch 2 encounters error.

test_cases.name: error_policy_quorum_threshold_success
test_cases.description: Branch failure occurs but remaining successful branches satisfy quorum_percentage (0.8), allowing progression to join.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-audit-003 with 5 branches, quorum_percentage 0.8, and 1 failure.
expected_output_patterns: === FORK-JOIN DISPATCH INITIALIZED: Batch: batch-audit-003 Branches: 5 ===

test_cases.name: error_policy_quorum_threshold_breach
test_cases.description: Success rate drops below quorum_percentage, triggering BRANCH_EXECUTION_FAILURE and execution halt.
test_cases.input: Execute fork-join for batch-quorum-fail with 4 branches, quorum_percentage 0.75, where 2 branches fail.

test_cases.name: violation_barrier_premature_release
test_cases.description: Prohibits advancing to join phase while worker branches remain active before timeout.
test_cases.input: Attempt to trigger join reduction while latch > 0 before barrier_timeout_ms elapses.

test_cases.name: violation_non_orthogonal_tasks_detected
test_cases.description: Rejects task collection containing colliding target paths or shared mutable references.
test_cases.input: Ingest task collection where task 1 and task 2 both write to the same mutable file reference.

test_cases.name: violation_join_reduction_error
test_cases.description: Handles failure during payload aggregation and emits JOIN_REDUCTION_ERROR.
test_cases.input: Execute MONOIDAL_REDUCE on incompatible payload types triggering reduction exception.

test_cases.name: invalid_config_validation_error
test_cases.description: Initialization with invalid barrier_timeout_ms (< 500) or malformed batch_id pattern fails schema validation.
test_cases.input: Configure fork-join with barrier_timeout_ms 100 and batch_id invalid_id.
